environment.description: Same provider binary deployed in production Terraform Cloud workspace. LaunchDarkly SDK key configured via workspace variable set (TFC_VAR_SET_ID: vs-a8Kn2mRpQxYz). The flag 'enable-direct-path-resolution' was toggled OFF (serving false) on 2024-01-15 as part of incident INC-4421 remediation. Flag targeting rule: default variation = false, with no individual/segment targeting overrides. Flag status in LD dashboard shows 'Launched (Off variation serving)'. The workspace uses Sentinel policy set 'path-validation-v2' but this policy only validates state outputs, not resource arguments. Agent pool 'prod-agents-east' runs with non-root user 'tfc-agent' but the base_path /opt/managed-files is owned by tfc-agent with write permissions to subdirectories.

config.network: egress allowed to app.launchdarkly.com:443 via allowlist
